notes.title: Brutal Orchestra 1.4.1f1 Minor fixes
notes.content:
A small update focused on more modding options:

Fixes
[list]
[*]Fixed bug where Premature Excretion Ability was not being removed properly.
[*]Fixed bug where boss pearls were not showcasing properly if mods were being deactivated.
[*]Fixed bug where hidden characters were messing up the Character Selection Menu.
[*]Fixed Bug on Status Effect Application where it was not properly working as intended.
[*]Withering units won't die anymore if a unit dies and spawns another unit.
[*]Fixed bug where Fishing Rod and Can o' Worms were generating more items than intended.
[*]Showdown Ability icon fixed.
[*]Fixed The Orpheum environment layers so they show properly.
[/list]

Texts:
[list]
[*]Crooked Die Item now specifies that it only decreases direct damage.
[*]Fixed typo on Eviscerate Abilities.
[*]Updated Bone Spurs description so it is a bit easier to understand.
[/list]

Balancing:
[list]
[*]Bronzo's Bailout Ability will now heal 30 hp instead of fully healing him.
[*]Blood Gamble Ability fail condition fixed so even if the attack is blocked by Shield or Divine Protection it won't deal damage to the Party Member that uses it.
[*]Starvation Ability now has the Frail intent.
[/list]

Mods
[list]
[*]Increased the Ability Icons in Combat from 6 to 10 for Enemies and Party members.
[*]Made some Healing and Damage variables modifiable for easier modding access.
[*]If a Modded Item is missing its achievement it will showcase an error achievement.
[*]Added support for custom Modded Achievement messages.
[*]Made the Ability Generation function for characters modifiable for mods.
[*]Easy and Hard mode Mung and Jumble Guts Enemy Bundles are now different entities so modders can add their encounters to them without affecting the Easy mode.
[*]Added nearly all Passive icons to the Intents list for mods.
[*]Added methods to Status and Field Effect scripts so it is easier to remove content from them for mods.
[*]Added Specific Unit Targeting by Health to the BrutalAPI.
[*]Added Custom data for Combat Results for mods.
[*]Added Custom message options for Modded achievements
[*]Made Omitted fools independent from each Zone so it is easier for mods to add their fools into the omission list.
[*]Added a system to add custom Zones into the run.
[*]Added an option to load and swap Zones during a run for future mods.
[*]If a modded zone path doesn't end in a boss it will now show a Zone portal alongside the rest of the paths instead of only a Zone portal.
[/list]

Enjoy!

notes.title: Brutal Orchestra 1.4f3 Minor Modding additions
notes.content:
Yet another small update with some minor stuff:

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed Ol' Stumpy bug where it was only triggering with Oil-Slicked.
[*]Fixed visual issue where a party member getting a passive that they already had would show twice in the Overworld.

[*]Spawning enemies now let you set their starting health if you want.

notes.title: Brutal Orchestra 1.4f2 Minor fixes
notes.content:
Another small update with some minor fixes:

Fixes
[list]
[*]Added more checks on the Extra Options so it does not break for some players.
[*]Removed a sound during the interlude dialogue where Nowak was not saying anything.
[*]Fixed the fonts for the character unlock information that show on the character selection.
[*]Intent icons now appear over top of Character Field Effects.
[*]Enemy Shield Field Effect will be properly shown in front of enemies.
[/list]

Features
[list]
[*]Enemy Bonus attack Passives have now proper pigment costs just in case Mods add them into characters.
[*]Status Effects now showcase numbers upon decreasing in value.
[*]Formless now won’t reroll if the Enemy has Forgetful and no more abilities are available.
[/list]

Mods
[list]
[*]Made some variables modifiable so Mods have access to them. (Bimini’s cost, Fogs’ cost, Bronzo’s cost, Bronzo fight chance and base chance)
[*]Enabled some textures Read/Write for Mods to have access to them. (Shop Items, Treasure Items, Passive Icons, Attack Icons, Status and Field Effect icons)
[*]Prepared the Healing function to return any required information that modders might need.
[*]Added 5 extra custom functions to Status and Field Effects so modders can get crazier.
[*]Added Default Enemy Ability Sprite into the Enemy Database for easier access. Made the API also automatically set up that Sprite for Enemy Abilities.
[*]Added OnHealthColorChange Trigger.
[/list]

Enjoy!

notes.title: Brutal Orchestra 1.4 "Human Canvas"
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180538/e2ceb78b5c031d7be10f94bb6f0f323aa56f3a7e.png[/img]
Art by the incredibly talented [url=https://x.com/Gloomy_Bro]Gloom Dude[/url].

Something strange has happened: who added that item? Where did that boss come from?? Who are any of you people?!?

Brutal Orchestra now has Steam Workshop support!

If you have been enjoying Brutal Orchestra and want to see more updates, make sure to drop us a review here on Steam!

Outside of Steam Workshop support this update does not add much in the way of new content but does add many long requested quality-of-life features!

[b]So Behold, The Changelog:[/b]

[u][b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/?appid=1734320&browsesort=trend&section=readytouseitems]ADDED STEAM WORKSHOP SUPPORT!!!![/url][/b][/u]
(This is a clickable link, click it!)

[b]New Trophies[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Trophies, a new type of unlock that will replace the main menu skeleton as you complete major milestones! These can be toggled by clicking the currently equipped trophy.
[*] The classic default "Pale Skeleton" trophy has been named "Obscured Remains".
[*] Added Trophy "Purple, Yellow and Red", unlocked by completing achievement "The End?".
[*] Added Trophy "Tu Nombre", unlocked by completing achievement "I'll Make You Regret This".
[*] Added Trophy "The Brutal Orchestra", unlocked by completing achievement "All That is Mortal".
[*] Added Trophy "Portrait of Figure at Peace", unlocked by completing achievement "Brutal Orchestra".
[*] Added Trophy "Memory of Zdzisław Nowak", unlocked by completing achievement "Brutal Orchestra".
[/list]
[b]New Enemy[/b]
[list]
[*] Added "Your Save File" (Easter egg enemy).
[/list]
[b]New Passive Effect[/b]
[list]
[*] Added "Passive Full Reset" (Easter egg passive).
[/list]
[b]New Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] "Active Party" menu now features a number in the top left of each party member position to make their in-combat placement more clear before entering combat.
[*] In-combat party member abilities have additional icons denoting their pigment cost.
[*] Improved save file structure to be more stable.
[*] Added 4 additional save files for a total of 5 save files.
[*] Any dialogue can now be skipped by a button in the bottom right corner.
[*] Made inanimate enemies able to be moved by more abilities.
[/list]
[b]Item Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] Item "Gump Ming Goa" now affects Fennec.
[*] Item "Baltic Brine" can no longer cause overflow.
[*] Item "Blackened Toad" is now considered a Magic/Demon Fetish item for the purposes of "The Director's Final Frame" achievement.
[*] Item "Convergent Rage" is now considered a Knife item for the purposes of "The Director's Final Frame" achievement.
[*] Item "Purple Heart" is now considered a Heart item for the purposes of "The Director's Final Frame" achievement because we take pity on you.
[*] Items that prevent death now count towards "The Second Coming" achievement.
[*] Item "Surrender" will now heal the equipped party member 25% of their maximum health upon fleeing combat.
[*] Item "Ed's Tags" will now heal 10 health when fleeing (previously healed 5 health).
[*] Additional ability "Crown of Thorns" from item "Spiked Collar" now costs 1 Red Pigment (previously cost 1 Purple Pigment).
[*] Item "You Can Do It" now reapplies status effect "Spotlight" every turn to a random party member or enemy (previously had only a 50% chance of applying status effect "Spotlight" at the beginning of combat to a random party member or enemy)
[*] Item "Box of Medals" shop price reduced to 7 (previously 10).
[*] Item "Ichthys" now has additional secret effect of spawning a temporary Mung party member at the start of combat.
[*] Additional ability "Penance" from item "Skinned Skate" now costs 1 Red or Purple Pigment (previously cost 1 Red Pigment).
[/list]
[b]Party Member Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] Swapped the pigment costs of Bimini's "Expire" and "Skewer" abilities.
[*] Passive effect "Bone Spurs" now triggers even if damage received is 0. 
[*] Passive effect "Mutualism" now heals 1-2 health per turn (previously healed 0-2 per turn).
[/list]
[b]Menu Additions and Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Added "Save File" tab to options menu.
[*] Added "Localization" tab to options menu.
[*] Added "Extras" tab to options menu.
[*] Fixed scroll speed on "Loot" menu.
[*] Reduced size of arrow on "Rank Up" menu so as to not obscure any text.
[*] Made confirmation UI dialogue space smaller to better fit within its bounds.
[*] Added Final Boss Unlock Pearls to the "Active Party" menu to make it clearer who does and does not already have the relevant unlocks.
[*] Passive effects applied by items will now be shown on the party member in the "Active Party" menu.
[*] Added in-depth framerate options to options menu.
[/list]
[b]Localisation[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed various typos in the Spanish localization.
[*] Fixed various typos in the English localization.
[/list]
[b]Misc Fixes and Additions[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a longstanding issue with Heaven's "Come Home" animation.
[*] Made Heaven slightly more bigoted against purple people.
[*] Fixed a minor continuity error in Dimitri's unlock encounter.
[*] Fixed error with the intent icons of the ability "Connection".
[*] Fixed an error with Burnout's dialogue colour.
[*] Swapped placement of "Strangers" achievements "Mordrake's Untold Tale" and "The Director's Final Frame".
[/list]
[b]Modding Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Modded party members with 4 to 6 abilities by default will now show up properly in "Fools" shops.
[*] On the main menu, modded party members with more than 4 to 6 abilities by default will properly display all abilities.
[/list]

On another note, you can now download fan-translations of Brutal Orchestra via the Steam Workshop!
In particular we recommend the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3330032078&searchtext=]Italian[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3330478505]Brazilian Portuguese[/url] translations as they have been been worked on by some truly incredible fans! 

[h2]Notice About the Human Canvas Sale[/h2]
With every Major Brutal Orchestra update we host a one week sale of Brutal Orchestra. However, with The Human Canvas update, Steam is requesting we choose between a sale for our own update and a different fast-approaching Genre Steam Sale.

So to do both, we are delaying this sale until a month or two in the future so we can use the sale to spotlight some exciting mods the Workshop offers!

[h2]What's next for Brutal Orchestra?[/h2]
Well, you may recall our previous post mentioning a Vinyl Kickstarter for Brutal Orchestra.
Those plans will still come to fruition but our release window has been impacted by Talia's other project [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2290870/Clown_Meat/]Clown Meat[/url] needing a bit more time in the oven. We aren't confident if the vinyl will still be a Kickstarter but we are confident it will be happening once our schedule clears up a bit.

For the next little bit, Nico is going to get some well-deserved rest as this update is almost entirely his creation. Once Talia returns from the world of Clown Meat, discussion will need to be had regarding whether there will be more Brutal Orchestra either as a content update or even potentially a DLC...

Like always, if you want to see more Brutal Orchestra make sure to drop the game a review here on Steam and recommend the game to any friends you think might enjoy it!

Take care!

-[url=https://x.com/ItsTheTalia?ref_src=twsrc%5Egoogle%7Ctwcamp%5Eserp%7Ctwgr%5Eauthor]Talia[/url] and [url=https://x.com/nico_codrilo]Nico[/url]

Clown Meat, Talia's next game is still pretty deep in the oven but Brutal Orchestra hasn't been left in the dust! We've been hard at work on localizing Brutal Orchestra to Spanish (with other languages on the way).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180538/c02599ff2fae93dd2b3dd6f85d25144f22cc0233.png[/img]

There have been some difficulties with translating to Non-English/Spanish languages so we want the help of YOU! If you are a native speaker of French, Italian, German, Portuguese, Japanese or Turkish and have an in-depth knowledge of Brutal Orchestra we want to talk with you to make sure that our translations are up to snuff before we release them to the world! Come to [url=https://discord.gg/ApADCqwCzp]Brutal Orchestra's Discord[/url] and let's get discussing!

notes.title: Brutal Orchestra 1.3.3 "Loud and Clear!"
notes.content:
We live! This year is a quieter one for Brutal Orchestra as Nico and Talia have been primarily working on their respective upcoming games ([url=https://twitter.com/ItsTheTalia/status/1663321599989420032]Clown Meat[/url] by Talia) ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2427050/Munch/]Munch[/url] by Nico).

[b]Updates to Brutal Orchestra's Pricing:[/b]

Hello!

This section will be considerably less formal/ominous as I want to be very transparent around why we are increasing Brutal Orchestra's price to 19.99 USD (prices will be adjusted to an equivalent in all other territories). This price change will not effect players who have already purchased Brutal Orchestra.

Brutal Orchestra is the largest project Nico and I have ever worked on and we honestly couldn't be more proud of it. The sheer amount of learning and improvement we went through while developing it cannot be put into words, it's truly a project that transformed us as people. However being new developers who had never charged for our work before we severely undervalued our work/time. When it came time to price Brutal Orchestra, we were terrified. We were absolutely frozen solid by the fear of being accused of being greedy, not caring about players or being full of ourselves. When [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/42191473]Hellbent Games[/url], our publisher suggested that we price the game at 19.99 USD we (extremely naively) argued that the game should instead be priced at 9.99 USD. This lead to us compromising to a price of 14.99 USD, which honestly was still too low.

Brutal Orchestra is a project Nico and I love working on and we still have so much more we want to add  but a price point of 14.99 has proven to be too low, both in how much it brings in the door and how much it limits the price range of the potential DLC we have been slowly cooking in the background.

After seeing people fall in love with Brutal Orchestra and adding numerous small and large content updates, expanding the game beyond what we originally envisioned, we have finally built up the confidence to charge what Brutal Orchestra has honestly deserved since the beginning.

This change will not be immediate as pricing changes take time to be processed by Steam, so you may still have a few days to grab the game before its price update if you really want to squeak in at the 14.99 USD price.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180538/38eec985dd1d392a6f17357951a0f99fb26ac046.png[/img]

We are extremely excited for what the future of Brutal Orchestra holds.

[b]-Maceo + Nico[/b]

notes.title: Brutal Orchestra 1.02 "Who's Laughing Now?"
notes.content:
Welcome back!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180538/66d7c986f7e1e73d37dae07deb99c50f5b22abbb.png[/img]
Art by the incredibly talented Gloom Dude: https://twitter.com/ElmanoloC

Deep within the Garden the Giggling Minister is waiting. This new enemy has some terrifying tricks up his sleeve, but also comes with a fantastic music track that you may recognize from Brutal Orchestra's trailer.

We have been listening to your feedback and have updated Brutal Orchestra to include a new option to skip combat animations and an option to skip Brutal Orchestra's cinematics as well as many other changes.

We have lots more planned so keep an eye out! If you have been enjoying Brutal Orchestra and want to see more updates like this and larger content updates in the future make sure to drop us a review on Steam!

And now, the changelog.

[b]Content[/b]
[list]
[*] Added the Giggling Minister, a new enemy found in the Garden.
[*] Added a new music track to accompany the Giggling Minister.
[/list]
[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Party side Field Effects now display their duration at all times.
[*] Abilities that change values over time such as "Punch" and "Tears" now display their updated values when hovering over the party member that performs them.
[*] Added Cloud Save functionality.
[*] Added Linux support.
[*] Added an option to skip combat animations, making the game much faster.
[*] Added an option to skip cinematics by moving the mouse over the bottom part of the screen and selecting "Skip".
